Key points
The main objectives for the article are:
• To identify the essential functions that calcium exerts in our body.
• To describe calcium sources and the variability in their bioavailability.
• To review the current guidelines for calcium and vitamin D intake according to The Institute of Medicine of the National
Academy of Sciences.
• To describe the mechanisms implicated in calcium absorption and metabolism.
• To outline the health consequences of calcium deﬁciency or excess according to the new scientiﬁc evidence.
